result.question: What comes to the old prophet at the table?

readings.support: While they were sitting at the table, the word of the LORD came to the prophet who had brought him back

assessments.reason: Verse 13:20 states “the word of the LORD came to the prophet,” which matches “The word of Yahweh” as an equivalent translation.

result.reason: The passage explicitly says the word of the LORD/Yahweh came to the prophet while at the table.
